title: Dandadan Season 3’s Release Date Might Have Leaked (And It’s Sooner Than Expected)
content: Dandadan Season 3 was reportedly in production since the second season of the anime came to an end in September 2025, and its production was finally confirmed in December 2025, alongside a 2027 premiere.

title: Family Guy’s Stewie Spin-Off Expands Cast For 2027 Release
content: Creating new series based in the world of Family Guy is nothing new for the long-running animated series, with The Cleveland Show being a prime example of Seth MacFarlane stretching his wings.

title: Crunchyroll Adds New Assassination Classroom Film
content: Crunchyroll also began streaming the English dub for the second television anime season based on Yomu Mishima 's Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai Desu ) light novel series on Wednesday. The dub features a returning cast.
author: ANN

title: King of the Hill’s Season 15 Finale Perfectly Sets Up The Show’s Future
content: Hank Hill and his family have returned to Arlen, Texas, as King of the Hill’s fifteenth season picks up where its predecessor left off. While the Hulu animated revival has mostly seen older iterations of Hank, Peggy, and Bobby, along with various supporting characters, many fans had questions about what came before.

title: Netflix is Finally Streaming 2026’s Biggest Anime So It’s The Perfect Time to Catch Up
content: The biggest action anime of the year is now finally streaming with Netflix , and that means it’s now the perfect time to go back and catch up with it all. It’s been a great year for anime thus far , and there are still many major shows that fans are excited to check out through the rest of the Summer and Fall seasons.
author: ComicBook

title: The Live-Action Blue Lock Movie Releases New Preview
content: Blue Lock wasted little time in becoming one of the biggest sports anime franchises of all time. First arriving in 2018 as a manga from creators Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yusuke Nomura, the series hasn’t just continued to release new chapters to this day; it has also had a major impact on the soccer world.

title: Toonami’s Wildest Anime Gets a New Physical Release Ahead of Season 2
content: Since the Summer 2026 anime season is ongoing, several new anime series are being introduced to fans. The year is far from over, but fans have been introduced to dozens of exciting and unique shows. This also includes Rooster Fighter , one of the newest Toonami hits .

title: Inherit the Winds Original TV Anime Casts Ryōhei Kimura
content: The official X/Twitter account for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) revealed on Wednesday that Ryōhei Kimura will play Nagakura Shinpachi ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ).
